handwriting_cards.png is a SYNTHETIC regression input, not real handwriting.
Generated by tests.scenes.make_scene on 2026-11-11, using the installed held-out
font bank: H2O at (0.5, 0.34), NaCl at (0.5, 0.74), text_h=58, seed=11.
It freezes the camera pixels so rendering changes in Pillow/OpenCV cannot
silently change the end-to-end test. Accuracy measurements still belong in
bench_recognizer.py and eval_real.py; this image is not an accuracy benchmark.
